name: idpProxy
description: Response flow of the gateway's /idp API, which relays WSO2 IS's sign-in metadata and token endpoint. Points token_endpoint at the gateway, removes registration_endpoint, and keeps each user's ID token for the ID-JAG token exchange. Runs the IdpProxyMediator class from code/apim-idjag-policy.

policyAttributes.name: publicBaseUrl
policyAttributes.description: The /idp API's URL on the gateway, e.g. https://localhost:8243/idp
